# Commeronix

> Commeronix is a free, high-performance web utility suite, developer toolkit, and calculation platform engineered for speed, mathematical precision, and complete client-side data privacy.

## Overview
Commeronix provides real-time foreign exchange conversions, reducing-balance loan & mortgage EMI calculations, scientific arithmetic operations, NIST-standard metric-to-imperial conversions, client-side image compression & format transformations, text processing, diff checking, and an engineering blog. All processing executes 100% client-side in the user's browser sandbox with zero telemetry, zero data storage, and zero registration barriers.

## Core Tools & Capabilities

### Financial & Mathematical Tools
- [Scientific Calculator](https://commeronix.com/calculator): Standard pocket arithmetic and advanced scientific calculations (trigonometry, logarithms, exponents, square roots, factorials, percentages) with persistent audit history and memory registers (MC, MR, M+, M-).
- [Currency Converter](https://commeronix.com/currency-converter): Real-time foreign exchange converter supporting 40+ fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, PKR, INR, CAD, AUD, JPY, CNY, etc.) with 60-second auto-refresh.
- [Universal Unit Converter](https://commeronix.com/unit-converter): NIST-standard conversions across Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, and Speed.
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://commeronix.com/loan-calculator): Financial loan and mortgage amortizer calculating monthly payments (EMI), total interest payable, and yearly reducing-balance schedules.

### Media & Image Utilities
- [Image Compressor](https://commeronix.com/image-compressor): Client-side Canvas-based image compression targeting specific file sizes with live visual quality comparison.
- [Image Resizer](https://commeronix.com/image-resizer): Responsive aspect-ratio scaling (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, custom dimensions).
- [Image Format Converter](https://commeronix.com/image-format-converter): Instant conversions across JPG, PNG, and WebP formats.
- [Image to Base64 Encoder](https://commeronix.com/image-to-base64): Converts image files into Base64 data URIs, HTML `<img>` tags, and CSS rules.
- [Background Remover](https://commeronix.com/background-remover): Canvas-driven smart transparent cutout with adjustable tolerance.
- [Favicon Generator](https://commeronix.com/favicon-generator): Generates 16x16, 32x32, 180x180 Apple Touch icons and copyable HTML meta tags.
- [Color Picker & Converter](https://commeronix.com/color-picker): Interactive color wheel, HEX / RGB / HSL conversion, harmonic palette generator, and WCAG contrast testing.

### Text & Developer Utilities
- [Word Counter](https://commeronix.com/word-counter): Real-time word, character, sentence, paragraph, and reading time counter.
- [Case Converter](https://commeronix.com/case-converter): Case transformation across UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, kebab-case, snake_case.
- [Text Diff & Compare](https://commeronix.com/text-compare): Visual side-by-side diff highlighter showing additions and deletions.
- [Text to Slug Generator](https://commeronix.com/text-to-slug): Clean SEO permalink slugs with stop-word filtering.
- [Remove Duplicate Lines](https://commeronix.com/remove-duplicate-lines): Line deduplication, whitespace trimming, and sorting.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://commeronix.com/lorem-ipsum-generator): Placeholder dummy text generator by paragraphs, sentences, or words.
- [Random Text Generator](https://commeronix.com/random-text-generator): Cryptographically secure alphanumeric strings, UUIDs, and passwords.
- [Reading Time Calculator](https://commeronix.com/reading-time-calculator): Estimates reading and speaking durations.

### Engineering Blog & Knowledge Base
- [Engineering Blog](https://commeronix.com/blog): In-depth technical articles on Core Web Vitals, URL permalink design, and digital color spaces.
